description: Use this when someone cannot decide between a Galápagos cruise and a land-based (island-hopping from hotels) trip. Scores six answers (budget per person, how they feel on boats, remote islands or freedom, who travels, how far ahead they book, wish for town life) and returns cruise, land-based or a close call with the reasons and an 8-day cost comparison. Every answer is optional; a missing one counts as the middle option. Examples: "Should we do a Galápagos cruise or island hopping? I get seasick." / "¿Crucero o islas por tierra en Galápagos? Me mareo en barco."

boats.description: How do you feel on boats? fine = Fine, I sleep anywhere; queasy = A bit queasy; seasick = Seasick easily.

booking.description: How far ahead are you booking? 6_months_plus = 6+ months ahead; 1_6_months = 1–6 months; last_minute = Last minute, flexible dates.

budget.description: What is your budget per person for the islands (excluding your flight to Ecuador)? under_3000 = Under $3,000; 3000_5000 = $3,000–5,000; over_5000 = Over $5,000.

party.description: Who is travelling? couple_solo = Couple or solo; family_young_kids = Family with young kids; friends = Group of friends.

priority.description: What matters more? remote_islands = Seeing the remote islands (Genovesa, Fernandina, Española); mix = A mix; freedom = Freedom to choose each day.

town_life.description: Do you want beach time, cafés and evenings in town? not_important = Not important; some = Some; very = Yes, very.

name: land_or_cruise

link.description: Page on galapagosislands.info with these inputs filled in.
